data.name: Damage Reduction
data.description: At 9th level, a skald gains damage reduction. Subtract 1 from the damage the skald takes each time she is dealt damage from a weapon or a natural attack. At 14th and 19th level this damage reduction rises by 1 point. Damage reduction can reduce damage to 0 but not below 0. The skald grants this DR to all allies affected by his raging song. The current DR is %1.|SkaldDamageReductionAmount
